### PR_MCQ_H1: Cardiac muscle electrical coupling occurs via gap junctions situated in:

- A) Desmosomes
- B) Intercalated discs
- C) Neuromuscular junctions
- D) Tight junctions

> **✅ Answer:** B) Intercalated discs
> **Explanation:** Intercalated disc gap junctions permit electrical syncytium.
